Author: fire

Punchline: 第三方插件简介汉化、仓库体检与图标缓存
Description:
第三方插件简介汉化
第三方插件仓库体检：坏链检测，一键停用／删除，带备份与撤回
已安装插件图标检查与补下，图标缓存到本地，重开游戏不用重下
拦住插件安装器自动刷新

Localization of third-party plugin descriptions; repository health check with dead-link detection and one-click disable/remove with backup and undo; installed-plugin icon check with a local icon cache; keeping the plugin installer list from being reset by automatic refreshes.
